reviews.text: Quick appointment. Friendly and courteous staff. I felt my dog was in good and safe hands
Thanks Nora!!!

100% recommend this place. My first time trying a self-service wash. Very straightforward and nice. Everyone there made me feel welcomed and was so nice. I brought my toddler with me and they had no problem with him being with me (he was in his stroller). I did the self-wash and paid for nail trimming. Love it, they were super quick and so sweet.

I just rescued my sweet boy 2 months ago. He is a large dog and I was worried he would be too anxious. The staff did a great job working with him. They were patient and took their time allowing him to adjust to the services. He looks fantastic! I’m so happy with the level of service we received. Will definitely return,
Everyone is so professional and my dog was a mess and they did an amazing job to groom her . Thank you

I’ve been a happy petBar Alamo Heights customer for about 3 years. I am super picky about my maltipoo’s groom and our usual groomer Marianne always exceeds my expectations. However, Marianne is away right now and I’ve recently moved to Austin, so I haven’t been to petBar Alamo Heights in about 6 months. I went to another petBar location in Austin and I wasn’t pleased and haven’t went back since. However, I came to San Antonio and my maltipoo got a full groom from Carlos and Carlos has truly also exceeded my expectations and I am so pleased and his cut looks AMAZING! Looks like we will be traveling from Austin to San Antonio for his cut going forward! Please be sure to ask for Carlos on your next visit to petBar!

It was our first time here today. The girls at the front were very welcoming and kind. Three of my pups got groomed by Carlos and I think we are hooked! They look perfect ! I get nervous with them bc they get nervous and we have to drug them a bit but I am very happy with the results ! He is wonderful and listened to all of my call outs.

This was our first time at Petbar and the front desk employees were very sweet! They made sure we knew how everything worked and where it was located. We got lucky that there weren't many dogs in the facility as it was our pups first time so he was a bit nervous. All of the shampoo and conditioner options smelt amazing as well as the cologne they offered. We can't wait to go back next month :)
Always a great experience! Highly recommend!
First appointment at Pet Bar in TX with my 70lb lab, they did an amazing and fast job. He was also happy leaving his appointment which is always great to see!
My experience was great! Carlos did an amazing job! Definitely coming back in 3 months thank you so much!
Thank you!
Thank you for the 5 star review!!
I Love the  PetBar not only is it quick and easy but employees are super sweet and attentive. I highly recommend this place!!

Our first experience!
It was great ❤️
The staff was nice sweet and patient

Hoping to save someone else from the same frustration I had, the self service is actually first come first serve so if you book online, the time you book does not actually matter. Seems like a great facility and I'm sure I would have had a good experience. I waited 25 minutes past appointment time and then just washed my dog at home. So just an FYI to anyone else in this situation- the self serve dog was is first come first served.
Thank you for the STARS!! :)

I tried out Petbar today for the first time and I don’t have one negative thing to say, I loved it and I will be back! I adopted my german shepherd pup in October and have struggled with getting him fully dry after baths at home because shepherds have a thick double coat and my hair dryer isn’t efficient for drying him, so the high velocity dryer was a a game changer for sure and giving your dog a bath at the bath station will save your back from not having to bend down to bathe them in your tub at home! I would recommend bringing your own dog shampoo if you like your dog to smell really good afterwards, they do provide shampoos but they just aren’t very fragrant. I appreciate that self service appointments aren’t timed, you get to take your time without rushing. I was out in one hour. Definitely recommend!
Shelby is great with my little Bichon!

I’ve been dealing with a groomer and I thought they’re good until I found PETBAR by accident. I brought our dog to them and he came out like a prince!!! Highly appreciate your service and highly appreciate your professionalism and great work!!!
Very friendly knowledgeable staff. My dog is very difficult and the groomer did a wonderful job.
Outstanding!!! Best customer service
Great experience! Will be coming back soon!

Petbar is AMAZING! All the groomers are super friendly and very patient with my 14-year old Yorkie. The salon is always clean and well key. It’s easy to make appointments online and definitely recommend to anyone looking for a groomer!
Friendly staff, I highly recommend Samantha!
My pup has been going here for weekly baths for a year, and I've been really pleased with the service! They go over and above to make sure he's comfortable and clean!

While visiting San Antonio and being aware that Mr. Hank, our rescued Great Dane is reactive, we were searching for a way to “refresh” our 165 lb boy and survive the adventure. Everyone was very helpful & put us at ease about seeking to clean a dog reactive giant. Hank is clean, smells great and we ended up with a “free rinse” as well. Thank you so much for accepting us!

Just moved to the area looking for a new groomer, came across PetBar on Google and absolutely was the best choice! I called and they were so quick to get us in (like 45 mins) and the girls at the front were so sweet and caring! My husky definitely looked a little crazy due to moving and taking a while to find somewhere but they took amazing care of him and he came out looking like a whole new dog! Thank you again!

Super friendly staff, helpful and great with my big boi! He’s a scaredy cat but they were so gentle and patient with his nails and pad care. The wash was easy to use and the staff explained everything. I liked how they gave you a separate room for drying with ear care supplies, plenty of towels (my pup hates the dryer) and cologne. I wish I knew about this place sooner! We live in Helotes but will definitely drive over here again for baths!!

Took my 170lb Saint Bernard in for a bath and cut, he is very people shy and anxious so leaving him with a new groomer is always nerve wracking. They took great care of him and made him look very handsome and clean. I would definitely return. Just a bit pricey, but that’s to be expected with giant breeds.

We are very disappointed we have the monthly self service for our dog and we can not even use it because every time we go the rooms are very dirty and there’s  is 3 girl at front all they say there busy but they have time to be talking at the front between them I have to dry me dog at the front. They need to have the rooms clean and the bathtubs
Hi Abdul, please remove this review, you have not been to our store. Thank you!
The staff is very helpful! The self dog wash worked out great for us.
Thanks for the review Ramiro!
Pet bar was clean and roomy. The staff was friendly.  They offer discounts. Will be returning for service.
Hi Saddik, thanks for the review!

Really quick, easy, and full of equipment for washing your own dog! It was my first time using the self service bath for my large poodle mix & it went so well. Normally its hard to wash her at home since she's so big but it was so much easier here with the large tub, hose, and blower. Will likely come back in the future!
This was probably the best groom that Scooter has had in the four years that I have lived here! Thank you so much for taking care of him!!!

This was our Sophie Bee's first time visit to Planet Pet Spa. We are extremely pleased and excited to have found Planet Pet Spa for Sophie's grooming needs. They have a professional, clean, friendly and careing staff. Sophie turned out beautiful.  Thank you ❤️

I can’t say enough good things about the petbar! I’ve been coming here for a while to get my dogs nails groomed and they always do a nice job! I really needed my dog groomed but I’m always hesitant to do it because my prior groomer and my vet had said she can be hard to groom. I went in today and Lauren instantly put me at ease with how they would try to get her grooming done and make my dog feel comfortable. My dog really liked Lauren right away. The grooming service was very fast. When I went to get my dog you could tell she was so happy! Lauren did such a great job and made her look so cute! Said she did great, found what made my dog a little uncomfortable, worked around that and was able to clean her up, while making her comfortable with the grooming process. Everybody there is amazing you can’t ask for a better place to take your pets.
Aide is the best! 😍 She's super kind and attentive. I've been getting my dog ​​groomed by her for two years now, and the prices have stayed the same. I'm delighted and 100% recommend her.

Great experience!  I brought my recently adopted rescue pup in for her first grooming as she needed it badly.  She’s extremely timid and anxious, but the staff treated her with so much care and patience.  She was ready to go in a little over an hour and their prices are very reasonable and fair!
Service was amazing

After being told by two other grooming facilities that my Benny was aggressive I didn’t know where else to go. He would be groomed consistently when living in Arizona and never had a problem. I feared that the groomers I had gone to may have been too assertive with him because he is a very anxious dog. I brought him to Pet Bar today and Lauren was his groomer. I explained to her his history and why I had a hard time finding a new groomer here in Texas. Lauren was amazing and was able to get him cleaned up. She did not experience the issues the other grooming facilities claimed they had with him and that shows just how much care and how much of an animal lover she is. Everyone I encountered from the front desk to other groomers who were coming out to greet their clients had great energy and truly seemed like animal lovers. I will definitely be coming back. Thank you Lauren!

Was very expensive compared to the haphazard service. Over $100 with a normal tip is crazy for a 35 min service on a large, long haired dog. There are better options around that spend time on the dog and get them fully cleaned then fully dried. We asked if our dog was an issue driving the not clipped nails, not dry dog, etc., but they said she did fine.
Thanks Josh!!

I’m so happy we took our two Yorkies to PetBar today! They came home looking absolutely beautiful. I love my dogs more than I can put into words and always get nervous leaving them anywhere—but PetBar was amazing. The staff was so professional, and the whole process was quick—they didn’t have to stay long at all. I’m so grateful for the care they received! Highly recommend! ❤️

My first time going & I must say I will be back. Great customer service. Very knowledgeable on their services and equipment. We did the walk-in self serve and my favorite part was we didn’t have a set time limit. I was able to really treat my pup to a great bath. Love the entire process! Thank you & we will be back! I didn’t get the name of the girl that helped but she had glasses and was super sweet!
Great service and fast! Will be coming back
Friendly staff our dog looks great

Decided to take Nesta after we had a fun morning in the rain and it was so worth it! Made it so easy to really get in there and scrub and blow dry will be making this her new bathing place thank ya’ll so much!
Thank you!

Great experience! Friendly staff. Dog smelled great afterwards. I gave a four star as the area for drying did not have a dog ramp for our large dog to walk up on the table. Had to lift her up myself. The bath area had the ramp. Not a deal breaker but would be helpful. Will definitely be back!

Super friendly stuff, Great price for what they provide for your furry best friend,

1. Washing station, four options, tear less , shampoo whitening shampoo, dirty dog shampoo, creme rinse conditioner, you can adjust the temperature between hot and cold, drying station has variety of fresh spray ear products, dog brushes, let’s not forget they provide towels and aprons..
Thank you Nina for your help, and welcoming Gordo and I
My baby has never been so clean, will be back

Good experience, my doggie looks great, they need more of this and different locations in San Antonio.
Especially in the east side of a town
We had a wonderful experience taking our dog Charlie to Petbar. The staff were very nice and Charlie received a great bath & grooming. We will recommend Petbar to all of our friends.
Thank you Barbara!! We love making our customers happy.
Thanks for the stars!!
My was my first time going to Petbar for my pug, Marty and it was a great experience. I will be definitely taking Marty back next month for another self serve bath.
1st time user... great place, manned by great people! Will become a repeat customer! Made me & my baby dog feel very comfortable. So glad I found them!

5 stars isn’t enough!
I brought my husky to Petbar San Antonio after I attempted to groom her at home and totally botched it. She was severely matted, and past groomers had struggled with her—she would get anxious and even try to bite, so no one was ever able to fully groom her. It just kept getting worse.

From the moment we walked in, the staff was so friendly and understanding. Olivia, our groomer, is truly the BEST. She was patient, gentle, and worked absolute magic on my girl. She got every single mat out and gave her a beautiful, full groom—something no one else had been able to do.

What really stood out was the communication. They sent text updates and photos during the groom, which gave me so much peace of mind. I could tell she was in good hands.

I can’t recommend Petbar (and Olivia!) enough. They turned a stressful situation into a positive experience, and I’m so grateful. We’ll definitely be coming back!
Amazing Experience.
Mariana did a wonderful job grooming my dog! She’s very patient with him and provides the best service possible!
They did an amazing job grooming my Bichon.
Thanks Travis, we appreciate you!
Thanks for the 5 stars!!
Thank you for the great review!
Staff were great! Haircut under 2 hours when usually at other places it runs about 4 hours. And my girl looked great!!! Overall happy with this business!
We will definitely be back!

I LOVE THIS PLACE! I never want to take my dog anywhere else! For some reason, I have a really hard time bathing one out of the three of my dogs. She usually gives me a hard time, but this was the smoothest bath I have ever done for her. I think it had to do with the environment and the set up she was comfortable I was comfortable. It was a blissful experience!! Thank you, Connie for getting us set up. This is the go to spot for a self dog wash! I will be taking all three of my dogs here from here on out.

Groomer had good recommendations and talked with me for a second about what would work. I didn’t feel rushed or felt like they were just rushing “another dog” through. She Seemed very friendly and caring. They actually got my dogs nails cut when she usually acts up with it . My dog obviously felt good about it, she smelled great, looked great, and was out walking around instead of being held in a kennel when I got back which I thought was nice. Great experience and very appreciative for ease of booking after Petco had a mishap the day before so I needed this groom in a quick timeframe .

Update 4/1/25 - Loryn did an excellent job listening to what I wanted for my pup Lilou Very sweet and caring with attention to detail throughout. Highly recommend her :)

Thank you !🙏💪❤️
Thanks for the great review!
Friendly, efficient and caring!

They were so sweet with my puppy! My girl is only 3 months old and this was her first grooming experience - they were so patient and sweet with her despite all the puppy nerves. Will definitely bring her back!
Welcoming prompt, friendly and great staff wanting to please dog and owner. Great place to go for doggy care.

I took my dog in for a self wash. The wash station is excellent. They have multiple options for shampoo and conditioner. The wash station is elevated so no bending over which is nice since I have back issues. Once you complete the wash you go to a drying room where there are towels, a blow dryer, combs/brushes and a cleaning solution for your pets ears. Overall, it was a great experience. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful as well. No complaints whatsoever.

We decided to try petbar as they take larger breed dogs which is rare. We dropped them off for a bath and one for a full groom and cut. Pricing was better than other chain groomers in the area and the ease of booking online is amazing for us as I don't have a lot of time to call around for appointments. We didn't use the self serve wash stations, but we may in the future. We will likely be back!
Kind workers. I ran a bit late picking up my dog and they were very understanding and patient. Dog looks great and clearly had a great time.
Best place to take your pets best staff very friendly lots to offer for self service
Love how accommodating the staff were about a schedule change.  Friendly and efficient!

Friendly staff, clean facility, and no wait for self-service dog wash although it was busy. Only issues were the “soap free” shampoo - could not tell if it was even dispensing but used what I brought from home, the conditioner was out - again had brought extra, and the blow dryers are not heat adjustable. Dryers just sort of blow a tepid air so it took quite a while to dry a Bernadoodle. That would be the improvement I’d suggest. Otherwise was a pleasant experience for our pup and me; cannot beat the price - $20. Much easier  than doing it in a bathtub at home
They took my dog very last minute for a bath ! Everyone was super kind and welcoming !!
Thanks for the 5 stars!
Thanks for the great review!!

Shoutout to Zasha for helping us out last minute with allll of my dog’s needs today! We’ve been bringing our girl to PetBar - Alamo Heights ever since we moved here and it has always been the best experience.

Thanks to everyone who has bathed, groomed, trimmed, etc. my River girl. Y’all are amazing. Top notch customer service.

We love bringing Lola to this PetBar to give her a bath. Friendly staff, clean (although our furry baby likes to shake it off!).
We give her a bath, blow out the fur, brush the hair and leave. It’s quick and easy.
Used the self-service wash - it was great and the staff was very friendly. Would highly recommend.
Quality grooming and kinda staff.
Loved the service!!! The grooming was on point! My dog was happy and came out looking super cute 🩷. We are definitely coming back! Also the girls were super nice and helpful 10000000/10 :) …

My dog was sprayed by a skunk and they did an awesome job getting the smell off. Were clear about residual odor if he gets wet and recommend a second wash in a couple of weeks. Very pleased with the results. Thank you.

Did self service first thing on a Saturday and was in and out in 30 min. They have everything you need and my dog got clean fast and without me breaking my back in the tub at home! Will be coming back and my dog will be clean way more often!

They always make my dogs look so cute that I cuss at my dogs to tell them how perfect they are. I also love that the groomers send me updates and text me before doing something they're not sure I'm ok with. Those two were scruffy and now they're cute. I'll always go back and I trust them with my dogs.

Update: Petbar makes other people cuss because the cuteness is unbearable. See photo of text.
Thanks for the review Teresa!
Petbar on Broadway is amazing,  friendly, and took very good care of my senior dog. Definitely recommend! I will be using this location again for sure! ❤️

Love love love this place!!! It is my first time trying them out and me and my puppy absolutely loved it!! Ms. Jamie was so gentle with my puppy and left him looking gorgeous! This will be our new grooming place from now on. Definitely …
Thank you for the review!! 👍🏻 …
We were very surprised seeing our lil Stormy. She looked so good and smelled so fresh. I highly recommend this groomer. She did EXACTLY as I asked when it came to her cut. We’ll definitely be back
We love PetBar and Shelby in particular! She does a wonderful job on our Pomeranian’s grooming, and we won’t go anywhere else.
